# EvoFlux FHM

EvoFlux is an open cowork, local-first AI agent workspace for FHM Q9, FPT, FPT Japan (FJP), and distributed engineering and knowledge-work teams.

Core product areas:
- Work: AI cowork for research, documents, data, browser work, and repeatable scheduled tasks.
- Coding: repository-aware software engineering with worktrees, tests, structural code intelligence, sandbox controls, and independent review.
- WebBridge: policy-checked automation in the user's real Chrome or Edge session.
- AIM: AI Innovation Modernization for governed legacy understanding, Rulebooks, target mapping, conversion, behavioral comparison, traceability, and cutover evidence.

Canonical website: https://evoflux.fhmq9.cloud/
English AIM: https://evoflux.fhmq9.cloud/aim/
Japanese: https://evoflux.fhmq9.cloud/jp/
Japanese AIM: https://evoflux.fhmq9.cloud/jp/aim/
Source: https://github.com/khuonghung/evoflux
